open_points.subject: backup contents after a concurrent agent-session change
open_points.text: “a later backup holds whatever the store holds when its own snapshot is taken” contradicts “A backup holds every record but the agent sessions (M06), which are removed from the copy before it is encrypted”
open_points.question: Is “whatever the store holds” subject to the explicit exclusion of agent sessions, or must a later backup include an agent session present at its snapshot?
options: Every backup excludes agent sessions, including sessions created during an earlier backup run
A later backup includes every record present at its snapshot, including agent sessions
open_points.default_guess: Treat “whatever the store holds” as subject to A18 rule 2 and continue excluding every agent session.

witness.initial: Registry is running with service tokens, the first daily backup is being copied, and agent session S is not yet registered.
events: Cabinet Kernel registers session S while the first backup copy is in progress; the registration commits and is absent from that snapshot.
At the next 03:00 UTC, Registry takes another backup while S still exists in the store.
The store is later lost, and the owner restores that second backup outside Registry.
outcomes: Under the new sentence, the later backup holds whatever the store held at its snapshot, so restored Registry contains session S.
Under A18 rule 2, agent sessions are removed from every backup, so restored Registry has no session S and Kernel must register it again.
witness.observer: Cabinet Kernel sees whether reading S's access immediately after restore succeeds or is refused as an unregistered session.
